params.body:
Closes #989

`Photo::old_remove_background()` read the original with a bare `get()`. The `vehicles` disk does not throw, so a read the bucket does not answer (a timeout, a 5xx) became null and went to remove.bg as an empty `image_file_b64`. remove.bg answered 400 `missing_source`, and the fault was reported (Nightwatch #61, three times on 2026-10-10, three platform copies that are in the bucket). `ProcessImage` stopped at that point, so those copies have no cut-out and no blurred plate.

The original is now read the way the sweeper reads it: `VehicleImageService::readSource()` inside `StorageUnavailable::retryOnce()`.

- Not in the bucket (or no path): `SOURCE_MISSING`, a warning, nothing sent, not reported.
- In the bucket but the bytes do not come: asked again once after a second. A second failure is a storage fault: reported, `SERVICE_REFUSED`, nothing sent.
- Bytes: they are what is sent, so the file is read once.

This also carries what #986 meant to do: that pull request was merged without the change in it (the proposal took the files from a HEAD that was never committed), so #984 is closed while nothing changed.

The two-copies-on-one-file case seen on the same vehicle is #990, not this pull request.

Tests: three cases in `RemoveBackgroundTest` (not there, fails once then reads, keeps failing), all three fail on main. Full suite green locally (3043 tests).
params.title: Read the original for remove.bg with a retry, and send nothing without bytes
